body:
Application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law for 720 Erbsville Rd
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that an application was submitted that is reviewed by city planners, other agencies and city council before anything can be built.
Sunvest Group of Companies is proposing the construction of 170 new residential units consisting of 58 townhouse units, 112 stacked townhouse units and 231 parking spaces.
Official Plan changes requested include:
allowing stacked townhouses that are 4 units wide and 4 units vertical with a total of 16 units, whereas the Erbsville South Block Plan limits stacked townhouses to 4 units in width and 2 units vertical for a total of 8 units
allowing a maximum building height of 12 metres for the proposed stacked townhouses, whereas the maximum building height is 10 metres
an increase in density to 155 bedrooms per hectare, whereas the maximum density is 150 bedrooms per hectare
Zoning By-law changes requested include:
rezoning the lands from Future Determination (FD) to Residential Eight (R8), Parks and Recreation (OS1) and Conservation (OS3)
a minimum interior lot line setback abutting the OS1 and OS3 zone of 3.6 metres, whereas the R8 zone requires an interior lot line setback of 7.5 metres
a minimum rear yard setback of 5 metres abutting the OS3 zone, whereas the R8 zone requires a rear yard setback of 7.5 metres
a minimum street line setback of 4.0 metres along Erbsville Road, whereas the R8 zone requires a street line setback of 6.0 metres
a maximum building height of 12 metres for a stacked townhouse building, whereas the R8 zone limits the maximum building height to 10 metres
notwithstanding section 3.D.2.6 of the By-law, decks and associated stairs are prohibited within 2.0 metres of the rear lot line, whereas the By-law prohibits decks within 4.0 metres of the rear lot line
prohibit the use of geothermal energy systems
View the documents submitted by the development company under Supporting Documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest building: 12 metres
Number of units: 170
Unit sizes: mix of one, two and three bedrooms
Housing types: condominium units
Parking
Parking: 231 parking spaces (1 per residential unit + 61 visitor spaces)
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the Planning Department.
Questions and answers
Questions and answers will be published on this site for public viewing. If your username includes your first or last name, or your email address, these will be available for public viewing. Do not include personal or identifying information in your question; if your question is of a personal nature, consider contacting a member of the project team directly. For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
Questions will be answered by a member of the Planning department within two business days. Some questions may require more time but they will be answered as soon as the information for the response can be collected.
